Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vikram - 36 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay sings a song.]

Hema (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay points at the sky.]

Hema: "What happened?"

[Tanay nods.]

Tanay: "Exactly right."

[Tanay thinks for a moment.]

Tanay: "Let's see."

[Tanay whispers something to Mother.]

Tanay: "Okay, Mom."

[Tanay takes the bag from Mother.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Tanay opens his umbrella.]

Tanay (softly): "Yes, of course."

[Tanay puts on his raincoat.]

Tanay (gently): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 3: The main road - Day

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Tanay sits in the back seat.]

Vikram: "Tanay, are you okay?"

[Tanay sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Hema (excited): "Tanay, look at this."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Tanay in the back.]

Vikram: "I knew it!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Tanay eats his breakfast at the table.]

Tanay: "Really?"

[Tanay takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay sips hot tea from a cup.]

Tanay: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Tanay gulps down a glass of milk.]

Vikram: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Hema: "What a day to remember!"
